_doc: Owner notifications (clearway/notify.py): each owner's webhook targets. Here every owner goes to the stand-in inbox on this machine (scripts/owner_inbox.py, http://127.0.0.1:8770/). A real target names the environment variable that holds its URL instead of the URL: "url_env": "CLEARWAY_HOOK_RAIL_CONTROL" (webhook URLs usually carry a credential, which stays out of this file), and optionally "secret_env" for the signing key. "snapshot": true sends the JPEG of the spot along: camera footage leaves the machine with it.
